Ram Mandir donation theft probe expands to accused's properties

An investigation into the theft of donations from the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya has expanded to examine the assets of the accused. Authorities are verifying documents related to a property registered in the name of an accused's wife, reportedly under construction. The probe aims to trace the source of funds for these assets, with one accused allegedly possessing significant wealth despite a modest salary.
